text: 中国9月以美元计价出口同比增长36.3%，预估为+25.7%。 中国9月以美元计价进口同比增长31.0%，预估为+25.0%。 中国9月贸易顺差1,335.3亿美元，预估为顺差1,177.8亿美元。 中国前三季度以美元计价出口同比增长21.3%，进口同比增27.5%。
text_en: China's September exports rose 36.3% year on year in US dollar terms, estimated at +25.7%. China's September imports rose 31.0% year on year in US dollar terms, estimated at +25.0%. China's September trade surplus was US$133.53 billion, estimated at a surplus of US$117.78 billion. In the first three quarters, China's exports rose 21.3% year on year in US dollar terms, while imports rose 27.5% year on year.
